newsitem.title: USA: Plaid Clothing sells all assets to Hartmarx.
newsitem.headline: Plaid Clothing sells all assets to Hartmarx.

text.p: Plaid Clothing Group Inc said on Wednesday that it has signed a letter of intent to sell substantially all of its assets to Hartmarx Corp.

Under the agreement, Hartmarx will purchase nearly all of the current assets, operations and licenses of Plaid, including the firms's manufacturing and distribution facilities. Proceeds from the sale will be available for distribution among the company's creditors, they firms said.

Plaid, a supplier of men's tailored clothing, has been operating under Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection since July, 1995, and has been in discussions with potential bidders for the company in recent months.
"We are convinced that this sale to Hartmarx is the best option for Plaid," said William V. Roberti, Plaid's president and chief executive officer.
